verdict_note: All Phase 5 checks pass. 115 net-new api-client tests were added (22 files / 455 tests -> 28 files / 570 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped) on top of the 20 tests the cook wrote (16 dashboard request tests + 4 auto-discovered endpoint checks). by_file.src/requests/dashboard/index.edgeCases.t: 33 NEW. Endpoint constants obey the endpoints.test.ts rules (starts /api/v1/, no trailing slash/query, no retired service segment, host != admin, same identity through requests barrel and package root, default window is an offered window). windowDays 7/30/90 for BOTH functions through the real client: exact URL, plain GET, no body; undefined omits the whole query; one /api/v1 only (no double prefix); no leak of a previous call's window. Values the types forbid (14, 0, -7, NaN, null, "30") are forwarded verbatim, never coerced/defaulted/dropped (the backend answers 400). Compile-time: parameter(1) is DashboardWindowDays | undefined, return types, DASHBOARD_WINDOW_OPTIONS is readonly [7,30,90], and @ts-expect-error for getHostDashboard(client, 14) / 0 / "30" / null / { windowDays: 30 }. production_concerns.where: packages/api-client/package.json (devDependencies) and the new test support files src/types/dashboard/javaContract.ts / javaWalker.ts
production_concerns.finding: The conformance test imports node:fs, node:path, node:url and process. @pte/api-client does not declare @types/node; typecheck passes only because @types/node is currently resolved transitively through vitest/vite. If that transitive dependency changes, `pnpm --filter @pte/api-client typecheck` would fail on the test support files (the package source itself does not use node APIs and is unaffected).
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Add "@types/node": "^20" to packages/api-client devDependencies (tenant-web already uses ^20). Not done here: package.json is outside the tester's write scope.

production_concerns.finding: Intentional and documented, not a mismatch: the Java map holds the four PteSection keys but also any non-standard section name found in data, so the string key is correct. The conformance test asserts the four standard keys are present.

windowDays is a compile-time union only. A value that reaches the function through a cast (0, 14, NaN, null) is forwarded as `?windowDays=<String(value)>` and is rejected by the backend with 400 INVALID_DASHBOARD_WINDOW; there is no runtime guard. The tests pin this as the intended behaviour (no silent coercion to 30, no dropping of falsy 0).
production_concerns.suggested_fix: None needed; consumers use DASHBOARD_WINDOW_OPTIONS for selectors.

observations: Contract text in the phase file says sections not yet delivered are typed optional; the final TS contract has no optional member (verified by a type-level test) because the backend always serialises every component (Jackson default inclusion; ApiResponse is @JsonInclude(ALWAYS)). The map section is correctly absent until Phase 10.

BigDecimal revenue amounts are typed number; the fixtures keep whole-VND amounts (1500000; originally fractional 1500000.5, changed in remediation cycle 1) as JSON numbers through a real-client round trip (OBS-P4-003 is therefore addressed on the TS side: format with Intl.NumberFormat per currency, never sum across currencies).
Test files stay under the 300-line limit (largest 274); fixtures were split into common/host/admin for the same reason.
